issue_title: Add batch support to export_row_transform hook
issue_body:
Extend the export_row_transform hook added in Stage 1 so that plugins can also implement export_rows_transform to receive a batch of rows (list of dicts) instead of one at a time.

If a plugin implements export_rows_transform it should be preferred over export_row_transform for that plugin. The single-row hook from Stage 1 must continue to work when no batch hook is registered. The public CSV and JSON export output shape must be unchanged.
prompt:
Extend the export_row_transform hook added in Stage 1 so that plugins can also implement export_rows_transform to receive a batch of rows (list of dicts) instead of one at a time.

If a plugin implements export_rows_transform it should be preferred over export_row_transform for that plugin. The single-row hook from Stage 1 must continue to work when no batch hook is registered. The public CSV and JSON export output shape must be unchanged.
expected_behavior: A hookspec named export_rows_transform is defined and callable.
Plugins implementing export_rows_transform receive a list of row dicts and return a list of row dicts.
When a plugin implements export_rows_transform, it is used instead of export_row_transform for that plugin.
When only export_row_transform is implemented, it is still called once per row.
When neither hook is implemented, output is unchanged.
CSV and JSON export shapes are preserved.
